title: Prime Number
description: A prime number is a natural number greater than 1 having exactly two distinct positive factors: 1 and itself.

example.question: Is 17 a prime number?
example.solution: 17 has only two factors: 1 and 17. Therefore, it is prime.

note: 2 is the only even prime number.

title: Composite Number
description: A composite number is a natural number greater than 1 having more than two positive factors.

example.question: Is 18 a composite number?
example.solution: 18 has factors 1, 2, 3, 6, 9 and 18. Hence it is composite.

note: Every composite number can be expressed as a product of prime numbers.

title: Prime Factorization
formula: Express a number as a product of prime numbers
description: Prime factorization writes a composite number as the product of its prime factors.
note: Prime factorization is unique for every composite number.

title: Co-prime Numbers
description: Two numbers are co-prime if their highest common factor is 1.
note: Co-prime numbers need not be prime.
